title: The Wormhole
venue_description:
The Wormhole Music Club and Bar

The Wormhole Music Venue and Neighborhood Pub has been a cornerstone of Savannah's Starland Design District for over a decade. What began as meager beginnings has grown into both a first-rate concert venue and a beloved neighborhood bar that successfully balances these dual identities.

Venue Character and Atmosphere

The Wormhole prides itself on friendly service and a neighborly vibe while avoiding pretension. The venue features billiards darts arcades pinball and classic video games including free-to-play NES Sega and Nintendo 64 systems. The space has a capacity of 300 people and maintains an 18+ age policy (21+ for the bar).

Food and Beverage

The full kitchen operates from 12 PM to 2:45 AM Monday through Saturday making it one of the few places in Savannah where you can get a hot fresh meal at 2 AM. The menu includes hot pressed paninis grilled wraps and half-pound burgers made with real ingredients prepared to order. The bar offers cocktails crafted with premium ingredients including fresh squeezed citrus (no pre-mixes) fresh herbs and muddled ingredients all affordably priced. They make their own salsa guacamole wing sauces and use fresh ground beef for burgers. An extensive non-alcoholic drink menu includes coffee and espresso.

Music and Events Programming

The events calendar includes weekly bar activities like trivia and karaoke alongside larger featured concerts. The stage hosts an incredibly diverse range of performances from metal festivals to bluegrass from electronica shows to square dancing. Notable headlining performers include Dick Dale HELMET Band of Horses Jonathan Richman Green Jello Particle and Papadosio. The venue has also hosted prominent comedians including Dave Chappelle David Spade Doug Stanhope Neil Hamburger and Kurt Metzger.

Open Mic and Jam Sessions

Monday nights feature the venue's renowned open mic and jam session from 8 PM to 2:30 AM voted Best Open Mic by Connect Savannah. All musical genres are welcomed from solo artists to full bands. The venue provides a full backline including house drums and keys with many instruments available for those who don't have their own. Musicians can play original songs or jam with others. Solo acts receive 10-15 minute sets depending on turnout while bands get 15 minutes with the option to sign up again non-consecutively. Every other Wednesday features jam sessions only (no open mic) from 8 PM to 2:30 AM. Participants include newly formed bands seeking stage experience professionals testing new material musicians looking to jam touring bands passing through and anyone wanting to join Savannah's music scene.

Venue Operations

The Wormhole is open Monday through Saturday from 12 noon to 3 AM with the kitchen closing at 2:45 AM. The venue is located near the intersection of Bull Street and 39th Street south of Forsyth Park in the up-and-coming Starland Design District. Booking inquiries should be submitted through their online form with phone/text contact reserved for shows happening immediately.

title: 208 Wine Bar
venue_description:
208 Wine Bar

208 Wine Bar occupies a historic building constructed in 1859 by John Stoddard for his thriving cotton trade on Upper Factors Walk just above River Street in downtown Savannah. For over 160 years this building has been home to various commercial enterprises and the current owners have preserved and captured the history while creating a vibrant modern wine destination.

Wine Selection and Expertise

The bar features over 50 wines available by the glass flight or bottle representing an eclectic selection from around the globe. The carefully curated list includes unique offerings like Tour de France flights and selections from India showcasing the bar's commitment to quality and variety. Owner Christina and her knowledgeable staff provide expert guidance helping patrons explore unique flavors and discover new favorites. The venue recently expanded to include cocktails in addition to wine becoming 208 Wine Bar and Cocktail Lounge to better serve diverse groups and special events.

Food and Atmosphere

While primarily a wine destination the venue offers a small thoughtfully prepared food menu that pairs well with the wine selections. Large windows provide picturesque views of ships arriving and departing on the Savannah River creating a serene atmosphere for conversation and relaxation. The intimate space accommodates up to 45 adults (all attendees must be 21+) and is available for private events and parties.

Live Music Programming

Every Thursday from 6:30-8:30 PM the wine bar comes alive with its popular Open Mic Night hosted by rising Savannah artist Brandi Olenyik. Known for her soulful blend of Americana pop and rock Brandi sets the tone before welcoming a rotating lineup of local musicians to share the stage. Each week offers something new from intimate solo sets to surprising collaborations making every performance feel fresh and personal. The venue also features live music performances every other Saturday adding to its reputation as a place where creativity and community converge.

Community and Service

The venue has become a gathering place for wine enthusiasts and music lovers alike. The warm hospitality passionate owners and inviting atmosphere foster a sense of community that resonates with visitors. The bar's dog-friendly policy adds to its welcoming character. Operating hours are Tuesday through Thursday 2-9 PM Friday 2-10 PM and Saturday 12-10 PM (closed Sunday and Monday). The venue offers the perfect backdrop for music and community with its cozy downtown setting and perfectly curated wine list making it an essential stop in Savannah's cultural landscape.

title: Warehouse Bar & Grille
venue_description:
Warehouse Bar & Grille

The Warehouse Bar & Grille is a classic River Street establishment located at 18 E River St in the heart of downtown Savannah's historic waterfront district. This venue embodies the authentic character of Savannah's famous riverside area with cobblestone streets historic architecture and sweeping views of the Savannah River.

Music and Entertainment

Every Tuesday night from 8 PM to 11 PM the venue hosts Open Mic Night led by Brett 'Hitman' Barnard a talented blues singer-songwriter and guitarist. Hitman's expertise spans multiple genres creating an inclusive atmosphere for musicians. The weekly event welcomes performers playing blues alternative classic rock hard rock funk honky-tonk country pop psychedelic and rock music. This genre diversity reflects Savannah's eclectic music scene and attracts both seasoned performers and newcomers to the stage.

Venue Character

As a bar and grille on River Street the venue combines casual dining with live entertainment in a relaxed warehouse-style setting. The location accepts credit cards and provides an accessible welcoming environment for both locals and tourists. The River Street location means the venue benefits from high foot traffic and the vibrant atmosphere of Savannah's most famous entertainment district.

River Street Context

River Street is Savannah's premier entertainment corridor featuring historic cotton warehouses converted into restaurants bars and shops. The cobblestone streets and proximity to the Savannah River create a unique ambiance that blends history with modern entertainment. The Warehouse Bar & Grille fits perfectly into this setting offering visitors an authentic Savannah experience that combines Southern hospitality live music and riverside atmosphere.

title: El Rocko Lounge
venue_description:
El Rocko Lounge

El Rocko Lounge opened in 2016 as Savannah's destination for live entertainment on Whitaker Street in downtown Savannah. Located at 117 Whitaker St near City Market and River Street this retro-themed cocktail lounge has established itself as a key venue in Savannah's nightlife scene.

Venue Atmosphere and Design

The lounge features distinctive retro decor creating a classy yet approachable atmosphere. With a capacity of 150 people the space is designed for both intimate performances and energetic dance nights. The venue maintains a 21+ age policy and operates Monday through Sunday from 5 PM to 3 AM providing late-night entertainment options in downtown Savannah.

Bar and Beverage Program

El Rocko is known for its frozen cocktail specialties and wide selection of draft beers. The bartending staff has earned a reputation for skill charm and creating excellent drinks. Happy hour specials attract locals and visitors alike while the extensive beverage menu ensures options for diverse tastes. The venue accepts credit cards and provides both bike parking and street parking options.

Music and Entertainment Programming

The venue hosts a diverse lineup of live entertainment including weekly rock performances hip hop shows DJ sets and comedy acts. Thursday through Saturday nights feature live music from 9 PM to 1 AM. Tuesday nights are dedicated to Open Mic Night starting at 8 PM where musicians are invited to bring their instruments and jam all night with no cover charge. The venue's booking calendar includes performances from regional and touring acts across multiple genres from punk and garage rock to indie and psychedelic music.

Performance Space

The intimate performance area offers good acoustics and sightlines making it ideal for bands looking to connect with audiences. The space works well for both solo performers and full bands with past bookings including acts like Pink Beds Penelope Road Boyscott and Manor Gates. The venue's retro aesthetic and late-night hours make it a favorite among Savannah's music community and those seeking alternative entertainment options downtown.

title: Mint to Be Mojito Bar and Bites
venue_description:
Mint to Be Mojito Bar and Bites

Mint to Be Mojito Bar and Bites is located at 12 W State St tucked away in a quiet corner of downtown Savannah. This Latin-inspired establishment focuses specifically on the art of crafting the perfect mojito while also serving authentic Latin American bites creating a unique niche in Savannah's beverage and dining scene.

Mojitos and Beverage Program

The bar specializes in handcrafted mojitos made with fresh fruit hand-muddled with passion and energy. The menu includes classic mojitos as well as creative variations featuring strawberry coconut passionfruit pineapple and seasonal flavors like very berry. Fresh ingredients including real fruit and lime are made to order ensuring quality and authenticity. Non-alcoholic versions of their famous mojitos are available for those preferring alcohol-free options. The beverage program reflects Latin American cocktail traditions with attention to detail and presentation.

Food Menu

The kitchen serves delicious Latin American homemade recipes including empanadas tamales papa rellenas arepas and Cuban sandwiches. All food is made with love using fresh quality ingredients. The empanadas have earned particular praise from customers while the tamales feature silky texture and flavorful fillings wrapped in banana leaves providing a delightful twist on traditional recipes. Vegetarian options are available catering to diverse dietary preferences.

La Aparicion Speakeasy

Hidden behind the bar accessed through a coded bathroom door is La Aparicion an upscale speakeasy lounge. This secret space features vibey decor with an antique-trendy forest aesthetic creating an intimate luxurious atmosphere. The speakeasy offers a solid cocktail selection and serves drinks with little lights for added ambiance. La Aparicion is available for private parties and special events with catering options. The venue also hosts Cocktail Classes on select dates teaching participants how to make special Latin American craft cocktails.

Live Music and Entertainment

Every Sunday evening from 6 PM to 9 PM the venue hosts Open Mic Night led by Jacob Evans an R&B soul and pop singer-songwriter. Evans delivers soulful performances with smooth vocals and a playful endearing vibe setting the tone before welcoming rotating local talent to share the stage. The intimate setting with Latin music playing throughout creates a warm energetic environment perfect for live performances.

Venue Details and Atmosphere

The establishment features both outdoor and indoor seating with an inviting decor that complements the Latin theme. Operating hours are Monday-Tuesday 11:30 AM-10 PM Wednesday 11:30 AM-10:30 PM Thursday 11:30 AM-12 AM Friday 11:30 AM-1 AM Saturday 11:30 AM-1:30 AM and Sunday 11:30 AM-10 PM. The venue accepts credit cards and offers bike parking and street parking. The family-owned business is known for kind service warm hospitality and making guests feel at home creating a community gathering spot in downtown Savannah.

title: The Sentient Bean
venue_description:
The Sentient Bean

The Sentient Bean is an independently owned cafe and vegetarian restaurant located at 13 E Park Ave directly across from Forsyth Park in the heart of historic Savannah. Since opening the venue has become a gathering space dedicated to conscious consumption community activism and creative expression earning recognition as Best Coffeehouse Best Vegetarian Restaurant Best Indie Film Venue and Best Green Business in Connect Savannah reader polls.

Coffee and Food Philosophy

The cafe serves fair trade organic coffee and espresso drinks sourced ethically with attention to environmental and social impact. The menu features thoughtfully sourced food using organic and locally sourced ingredients often purchased directly from farmers. Homemade baked goods include whole wheat and gluten-free options ensuring accessibility for various dietary needs. The vegetarian and vegan-focused menu includes breakfast burritos savory bowls innovative pastries vegan pancakes tofu scramble tacos omelettes breakfast sandwiches and house-made vegan sausage patties. Sunday brunch runs from 9 AM to 12 PM while happy hour operates daily from 5-9 PM featuring $5 wine and $3 beer.

Atmosphere and Design

The space features high vaulted 22-foot wood ceilings an open layout and artistic eclectic decor creating an aesthetically pleasing environment. The cafe buzzes with positive energy attracting a diverse community of locals and visitors. Seating includes counter seats facing Park Avenue tables in the center and additional seating in the back room. The venue is completely wheelchair accessible with an accessible entrance and restroom facilities. Operating hours are 7 AM to 7 PM seven days a week.

Events and Performance Space

Most evenings the dining room converts into an intimate listening room with a modest 5x7 ft stage that can seat up to 50 people or accommodate 70 standing. The room's bouncy acoustics favor acoustic music but the venue welcomes diverse programming including live music poetry comedy burlesque small-scale theater drag and film showings. The space provides a platform for community forums and activism-related events reflecting the cafe's commitment to social engagement.

Open Mic and Music Programming

Every 1st and 3rd Tuesday the venue hosts Tongue open mouth and music night. Sign-up begins at 6:30 PM with performances starting at 7 PM. This anything-goes open mic emphasizes new original thoughtful work and is free open to all and family-friendly. The event welcomes poetry music singing drag and performance art creating a true community talent showcase. Additional events throughout the week include concerts art exhibitions community meetings and cultural programming. All booking inquiries are handled via email with the venue seeking acoustic-friendly performances that align with their intimate space.

Community Impact

The Sentient Bean serves as more than a cafe—it's a community hub where consciousness and creativity converge. The venue's dedication to sustainability fair trade practices environmental stewardship and inclusive programming has made it a beloved institution in Savannah. Whether visitors are enjoying a lavender habanero latte working on laptops attending a concert or participating in community events The Sentient Bean provides a welcoming space that encourages connection reflection and activism.
